 How to Watch Knicks vs Bulls

 Time: 8:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: Chicago Sports Network, MSG
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 New York picked up its first win of the season Tuesday, beating the Detroit Pistons 111-97 at Madison Square Garden. Karl-Anthony Towns led the Knicks with 27 points and 20 rebounds, shooting 12-for-21 from the field, while Jalen Brunson scored 23 points and added seven assists. OG Anunoby finished with 13 points and seven rebounds, and Mikal Bridges scored 12 points on four three-pointers. The Knicks trailed 38-25 after the first quarter but held Detroit to just 25 combined points in the second and third quarters, taking control.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Chicago has lost two straight games after falling 134-99 to the Boston Celtics on Monday. Norman Powell scored a team-high 20 points and added four steals, while rookie Caleb Wilson finished with 17 points, five rebounds and three assists. Josh Giddey contributed 11 points and four assists, and Leonard Miller grabbed nine rebounds off the bench. The Bulls trailed by 12 points at halftime before Boston outscored them 39-21 in the third quarter to pull away. Chicago made just 12 of its 44 three-point attempts and was outrebounded 54-40 in the loss.
